system.name: Spindle
system.one_liner: a training system for multi-task multi-modal large models that plans and schedules execution via wavefront scheduling

components.name: Computation Graph
components.role: graph representation of user-defined multi-task multi-modal training tasks

components.name: GPU Cluster
components.role: target hardware cluster profiled to inform planning decisions

components.name: Graph Contraction
components.role: first execution-planner stage that contracts the computation graph into a MetaGraph with MetaOps

components.name: Scalability Estimator
components.role: estimates scaling curves for tasks using cluster profiling data

components.name: Resource Allocator
components.role: produces an allocation plan assigning devices/resources to tasks

components.name: Wavefront Scheduler
components.role: produces a wavefront schedule for dependency-driven execution

components.name: Device Placement
components.role: produces the final execution plan mapping tasks to devices over a timeline

components.name: Runtime Engine
components.role: executes the generated execution plan and trains the model on the GPU cluster

content.key_idea: Spindle sequentially contracts the computation graph, estimates scalability, allocates resources, and produces a wavefront schedule and device placement before the runtime engine trains the model on the GPU cluster.
content.reading_order: Top-left inputs (Computation Graph, GPU Cluster) feed into a top-to-bottom pipeline of five execution-planner stages, ending at the Runtime Engine at the bottom.

summary: Spindle is a training system for multi-task, multi-modal (MT MM) large models that uses wavefront scheduling to jointly optimize workload parallelization and execution scheduling. This architecture-overview figure shows the Execution Planner as a top-to-bottom pipeline of five stages: Graph Contraction (turning the input Computation Graph into a MetaGraph of MetaOps), Scalability Estimator (producing scaling curves using GPU Cluster profiling), Resource Allocator (producing an allocation plan), Wavefront Scheduler (producing a wavefront schedule), and Device Placement (producing the final execution plan). Each stage box is paired with a small red-labeled thumbnail illustrating its output artifact. The resulting execution plan flows into the Runtime Engine within the dashed Training Framework group at the bottom, which trains the model on the GPU cluster, closing the loop between planning and execution.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Spindle 的整体架构：执行规划器自上而下依次经过图收缩、可扩展性估计、资源分配、波前调度和设备放置五个阶段，每阶段旁配有输出产物示意图，最终执行计划交给运行时引擎在 GPU 集群上完成训练。
